does_not_cover: Never runs a t, chi-square, rank, or permutation test despite the testing title scope.
Never builds a confidence interval or shows test/interval duality.
Never touches multiple testing, error rates beyond passing mention, or nonparametric alternatives.
notes: Concept-first pacing with one worked Z example plus simulations. Power and sample-size effects shown visually belong to errors-power; uniform-distribution detail is unusually thorough.

segments.topic: Definition: p-value as conditional probability under the null
Worked Z example for a normal mean giving p near 0.02
Reject rule against alpha and evidence-strength language
Uniform distribution of p under the null with mean 0.5
Million-sample simulations: false nulls shift p toward zero, n=50 boosts power
Rough guideline table from very strong to no evidence

suggested_locator: 00:55-02:52 for the worked example; 05:06-09:03 for the simulation intuition

teaches.why: Computes a right-tail area and generalizes smaller p to stronger evidence.
Sets up null, Z statistic and its reference distribution explicitly.
Shows larger n shifts p toward zero and names greater power.
